title: FinanceOS
description: Tracking my finances in Excel was completely manual, every transaction logged by hand. I built a full-stack app to replace it, with bank statement import, a rule-based alert engine, and a debt payoff simulator. Direct bank sync turned out not to be possible (banks don't allow direct access and the aggregator options didn't meet my security bar), so statement import is the automation path for now.
features: Debt tracker for credit cards, loans and BNPL, with an Avalanche vs. Snowball payoff simulator
CSV/XLSX bulk import from real bank statement downloads
Rule-based alert engine with 14 rule types (over-budget, spending spikes, bills and debts due, low balance), delivered through a Telegram bot

logs.event: Backend API and database schema completed
DB migration frontend and backend connection
